name: Catharina Gosnerin — daughter Magdalena Schedler (chr. 1743, Triesen)
researcher_question: Did Catharina Gosnerin and Joannes Schedler of Triesen, Liechtenstein have a daughter Magdalena, christened 12 June 1743?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 17, hint-samples.csv row 539, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Adjudicated as a FALSE MATCH: Joannes Schedler married Catharina Gosnerin at Triesen on 10 Aug 1751 (ark:/61903/1:1:XLG8-6ZS), eight years after the 12 June 1743 christening, and the indexed mother switches from Schedlerin to Gosnerin at exactly that date; the 1751 Josephus pair (15 Mar, ark:/61903/1:1:X5C1-98R; 12 Nov, ark:/61903/1:1:X5C1-9D3) corroborates. Findings are an avoid guard plus a required negative conclusion. One loose end noted and left open: the 1741 Antonius entry names Gosnerin but predates the marriage — it does not bear on Magdalena. No independent second reader was available; PR review stands in for it, so the reviewer is the second read. See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
